title: rosa coriifolia var. cenisia
intro: Rosa coriifolia var. cenisia, commonly known as a fragrant rose species, is a plant used in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Rosa coriifolia var. cenisia include its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, expectorant, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of Rosa coriifolia var. cenisia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
